summary: Repaired the one blocking finding carried from the iteration-2 study review (STU-013, repair target: study), the study-side consequence of the STU-001 research repair. The first interpretation's false sentence that Augustine 'says nothing of the seal or the number' is corrected: his three brief loci on the Lesson's chapter (De doctrina christiana III.35.51, Letter XCIII section 30, Sermon LXI 1) are quoted and presented as the short applications they are, never as a commentary on the chapter. Victorinus of Pettau now stands as the reading's second developed witness on the Lesson, in his own subsection and under the ANF editors' recension caution, agreeing with Bede that the crowd is the elect out of all believers cleansed by baptism in the Lamb's blood and disagreeing on the angel (Elias, not the Lord incarnate) and on the number (the believers at Elias's preaching in the last times, on 12:6). Cyprian's martyrs-only reading (Ad Fortunatum section 11) is kept visible as the rival Bede rejects at 7:14. The comparison's 'Where its witnesses differ' row and closing sentence now state the patristic disagreement on the number, the crowd and the angel beside the reception disagreement. Neither Victorinus nor Cyprian carries (no author-standing row); the manifest lane authors, the reception appendix and the References follow the new citations. The four standing advisories (STU-008, STU-009, STU-010, STU-012) were cleared while in those files. Generation metadata and research/production-review.md are updated, and a fresh author proof (32 pages) passes every preflight check and the web-edition probe.
